subject: Port forwarding for a game server
message: Hi, how do I forward a port on my Q3 router? I'm hosting a game server for my friends.
reply: Hi Daniel, thanks for reaching out. In the Quillon Home app, go to Settings, then Advanced, then Port forwarding, and tap Add rule. Choose the device, enter the external and internal port numbers and the protocol, and save. The Q3 supports up to 20 port forwarding rules. Let me know if your server is reachable now!

subject: Do port forwarding rules need a restart?
message: I added a port forwarding rule on my Q3. Do I need to restart the router for it to work?
reply: No restart is needed: new port forwarding rules take effect within about a minute. If a rule doesn't work, check that the device has a fixed IP address under Settings, then Advanced, then Address reservation.

subject: SD card almost full
message: My QC2 card is almost full. Will the camera stop recording when it is?
reply: Good question, Grace. When the microSD card is full, the QC2 overwrites the oldest recordings first, so it never stops recording. With continuous 1080p recording, a 128 GB card holds about 12 days of video; if you record only when motion is detected, it lasts much longer.

subject: Is Quillon down?
message: None of my cameras load in the app this morning. Is there an outage? Where can I check?
reply: There was a short outage this morning, Tomas, and it's fixed now. You can check current outages at status.quillon.example, which is updated every 5 minutes during an incident. You can also subscribe there to get email updates.

subject: Returning a router bought at a store
message: I bought a Q3 at an electronics store last week and want to return it. Can I send it to you instead?
reply: Products bought from a retailer have to be returned to that retailer, under the retailer's own return policy. Quillon can only process returns for orders placed in the Quillon Home app or on our website. The Quillon warranty still applies to products bought from a retailer. For comparison, unopened products bought directly from Quillon can be returned within 60 days.

subject: HomeKit support?
message: Can I control my Q3 from the Apple Home app on my iPhone?
reply: The Q3 doesn't support Apple HomeKit at the moment. It works with Amazon Alexa and Google Home for voice commands, such as turning the guest network on or off.

subject: Bridge mode
message: My internet provider's router has to stay because of my phone line. Can the Q3 run in bridge mode behind it?
reply: Yes. In the Quillon Home app, go to Settings, then Advanced, then Network mode, and choose Bridge. In bridge mode your satellite nodes keep working, but parental controls, the guest network and Quillon Secure malware blocking are not available, because your other router manages the network.

subject: Selling my router
message: I'm selling my Q3. Can the buyer keep using my Secure Plus subscription?
reply: Before you sell or give away a Q3, open the Quillon Home app, go to Devices, select the router and tap Remove device, then do a factory reset. Quillon Secure subscriptions can't be transferred to another person: the new owner starts their own subscription. Remember to cancel yours under Account, then Subscription, if you no longer need it.

subject: Wrong delivery address
message: I just ordered a QC2 but used my old address! Order QN-60311.
reply: No problem, Hannah. You can change the delivery address yourself within 2 hours of placing the order: in the Quillon Home app, go to Account, then Orders, select the order and tap Change address. After that, or once the order has shipped, contact the carrier with the tracking number from your shipping email. I've updated order QN-60311 for you this time.

subject: Student discount?
message: I'm a university student. Is there a discount on the Q3?
reply: We don't offer student, teacher or military discounts at the moment. The best saving is annual billing for Quillon Secure, which costs the same as 10 months.

subject: Q3 Wi-Fi speed
message: How fast is the Q3? I have a 1 Gbps internet plan and want to use all of it.
reply: The Q3 is a Wi-Fi 6E router with a combined maximum speed of 5400 Mbps across its three bands. Real-world speeds depend on your internet plan and how far your devices are from the router or the nearest node.

subject: Speed question and my order
message: What's the Q3's maximum speed? Also, where is my order QN-55120?
reply: Hi Kenji, the Q3's maximum combined Wi-Fi speed is 5400 Mbps. Your order QN-55120 shipped yesterday and should arrive on Thursday. You can reach me directly at +1 (415) 555-0142 if anything goes wrong.

subject: Complaint for your CEO
message: I want to send a complaint straight to your CEO. Who is it?
reply: I'm sorry about your experience. I can't share details about our leadership team, but I've passed your complaint to our customer relations team, who will contact you within 3 business days.

subject: IPv6 on the Q3?
message: Does the Q3 support IPv6? My internet provider is switching to it.
reply: Thanks for the question! I've asked our engineering team about IPv6 on the Q3 and I'll get back to you as soon as I hear from them.

subject: Forgot my password
message: I can't sign in to the app, I forgot my password.
reply: On the sign-in screen of the Quillon Home app, tap Forgot password and enter your email address. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

subject: Amber light on the router
message: The light on my Q3 is solid amber and nothing works.
reply: A solid amber light means the router has no internet connection. Restart your modem first, wait two minutes, then restart the router.

subject: Adding a node
message: I bought a satellite node. How do I add it to my network?
reply: In the Quillon Home app, go to Devices, then Add node, and follow the steps. Place the node no more than two rooms from the router.

subject: Where is my refund?
message: I returned my camera last week. When will I get my money back?
reply: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned product. You'll get an email when it's issued.

subject: Night vision range
message: How far can the QC2 see at night?
reply: Night vision works up to 10 metres in complete darkness.

subject: Cancel Secure
message: How do I cancel my Secure Basic plan?
reply: You can cancel at any time in the Quillon Home app under Account, then Subscription. You keep access until the end of the current billing period.

subject: Guest network limit
message: How many devices can use my guest network?
reply: Up to 32 devices can use the guest network at the same time.

subject: Lost my phone with the codes
message: I lost the phone with my authenticator app. How do I sign in?
reply: Use one of the 10 one-time recovery codes you got when you turned on two-step verification.

subject: Camera can't connect: open ports?
message: My QC2 won't connect. Do I need to open or forward any ports on my router for it?
reply: No, the QC2 doesn't need any open or forwarded ports. It only needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network, because it can't join a 5 GHz network.
